fault_desc: deny-ingress NetworkPolicy on payment, pod reconnects
diagnosis: Checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls fail with HTTP 500 and checkout journeys are failing 100%. The payment pods are healthy and their logs show no recent charge requests. NetworkPolicy payment-ingress (trust-lab) was created at 20:54:27, about 27 s before the alert, outside the change log. It selects app.kubernetes.io/name=payment and declares policyTypes Ingress with no ingress rules, which denies all inbound traffic to the payment pods, so checkout cannot reach payment. The fix is to delete or correct that NetworkPolicy, which is not an allowed action here, so a human needs to act. Evidence gap: checkout's own logs were empty, so the link to the policy is inferred from timing, the deny-all spec, and the absence of payment traffic.
